_doc: Every class Farhold can be played as — all 30 from Emberveil, because the looks, the passive trees and the names already exist there and inventing a second, smaller list would only make the game poorer. `skills` comes from data/skills.json; `starter` is what the character has in hand on the first morning; `pet` is the companion the class brings, driven by js/pets.js. `armorTier` is what the class can wear and `weapons` is what it can hold — rpg.js refuses anything else.

classes.name: Warrior
classes.hook: Shield Bash stuns enemies. Whirlwind hits all adjacent foes. Unbreakable when outnumbered.

classes.name: Fighter
classes.hook: Riposte counters parries. Tactical stances swap between offense and defense. Precise Strike never misses.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.hook: Holy Strike crits vs demons. Lay on Hands keeps allies alive. Consecration sustains long fights.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.hook: Aimed Shot ignores armor. Rain of Arrows blankets the entire enemy field for 3 rounds.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.hook: 200% Backstab on stunned targets. Death Mark makes enemies take 50% more damage from all sources.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.hook: Mass Resurrection can auto-trigger on wipe. Sanctuary makes an ally temporarily untargetable.

classes.name: Bard
classes.hook: Ballad of Valor gives one hero two turns per round. Song of Ruin strips all enemy buffs at once.

classes.name: Mage
classes.hook: Fireball torches entire enemy packs. Blizzard hits all enemies for 3 rounds. Arcane Surge: 400% INT.

classes.name: Necromancer
classes.hook: Raise Dead turns corpses into skeleton allies. Death Coil applies Poison AND Bleed to all enemies.

classes.name: Warlock
classes.hook: Corruption spreads on enemy death. Soul Pact doubles all DoT at cost of own HP.

classes.name: Demon Hunter
classes.hook: +50% damage vs demons. Vengeance stacks from fallen allies then unleashes devastating burst.

classes.name: Scavenger
classes.hook: Lucky Strike inflicts random statuses. Big Score is a high-variance gambling strike — crit huge or whiff.

classes.name: Swashbuckler
classes.hook: Build Flair stacks with Flourish. Grandeur releases all stacks in one legendary strike.

classes.name: Dragon Knight
classes.hook: Choose fire/ice/lightning. Draconic Fury turns all attacks into group AoE for 2 rounds.

classes.name: Pyromancer
classes.hook: Stack Burn on multiple groups. Meteor ignites every enemy group simultaneously.

classes.name: Stormcaller
classes.hook: Chain Lightning jumps between enemies. Thunder Ring zones the battlefield.

classes.name: Druid
classes.hook: Rejuvenation HoTs. Wild Shape for raw damage. Nature’s Wrath in the late game.

classes.name: Oracle
classes.hook: Foresight pre-shields allies against incoming damage. Prophecy reveals enemy intents.

classes.name: Tactician
classes.hook: Grants extra actions, repositions allies, reshuffles enemy turn order.

classes.name: Chronomancer
classes.hook: Haste allies, slow enemies, rewind HP, freeze the battlefield in Time Stop.

classes.name: Monk
classes.hook: Unarmed flurries stack chi. Inner Focus self-heals. Shadow Step dashes into crit range.

classes.name: Shaman
classes.hook: Totems heal over time. Spirit bolts chain to nearby foes. Ancestral Shield wards the party.

classes.name: Witch Hunter
classes.hook: Silver bolts purge curses. Bonus damage vs demons and undead. Marks targets for the party.

classes.name: Knight
classes.hook: Shield Bash stuns, Taunt locks aggro, Holy Strike sears evil, Rally bolsters the party.

classes.name: Sorcerer
classes.hook: Wild Bolt rolls a random element. Arcane Surge doubles spell power. Mana Burn punishes casters.

classes.name: Runesmith
classes.hook: Rune Hammer hits with imbued force. Wards protect allies. Forge Flame ignites weapons.

classes.name: Shadow Dancer
classes.hook: Smoke Veil grants evasion. Assassinate executes low-HP foes. Dance of Blades chains strikes.

classes.name: Tinker
classes.hook: Clockwork bolts, alchemical grenades, and a pocket-watch that patches wounds mid-fight. Overcharge the whole party with an arcane spring-wound battery.

classes.name: Priest
classes.hook: Heals the living, calls back the fallen, and answers their killers with shadow. The party's reviver and second-line damage dealer.

classes.name: Enchanter
classes.hook: Lulls foes to sleep so the party can pick its fights. Drowse opens packs without alerting them. Arcane Jolt wakes targets only when you decide they should die.
